title: storage/pkg/idtools: make libsubid reading thread safe
body:
Currently the functions exposed by libsubid are not thread safe[1], trying to read the idmappings from multiple goroutines at once fails to find any mapping.

The downstream user in podman, GetConfiguredMappings() ignores the errors so for a container using keep-id mode the extra id mappings are silently lost. The problem is that the API service of course must be able to handle multiple container create requests in parallel so if that is the case mappings get lost "randomly" for users who only notice this later when the container doe snot work correctly.

[1] https://github.com/shadow-maint/shadow/issues/1362

Fixes: podman-container-tools/podman#29848
